name: Sensor Tower
description: Enterprise mobile market intelligence for app metadata, category rankings, modeled downloads and revenue, and aggregate game-market estimates across iOS and Android.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: API Authentication Token
credential_fields.description: Sensor Tower API auth token. API access is contract/plan-gated and normally provisioned by Sensor Tower rather than through self-service signup.

tools.name: get_app_metadata
tools.description: Get metadata for one or more platform-specific or unified apps. Use numeric App Store IDs for iOS and package names for Android.

app_ids.description: Comma-separated platform app IDs or Sensor Tower unified app IDs.

attributes.description: Optional extra attribute set, for example contact_info.

app_id_type.description: Use unified when querying unified IDs.

tools.name: get_category_rankings
tools.description: Get ranked apps for a platform category, country, chart type, and date. Chart naming differs between iOS and Android; use the enum values matching the selected platform.

category.description: Sensor Tower category ID, such as 6014 for iOS Games.

date.description: Ranking date; the API requires this value.

tools.name: get_sales_estimates
tools.description: Get Sensor Tower modeled download and app-store revenue estimates for one or more apps by country and date. Raw revenue values are returned in cents.

app_ids.description: Comma-separated platform or unified app IDs.

countries.description: Comma-separated country codes, or WW for worldwide.

tools.name: get_game_market_summary
tools.description: Get aggregate game-market download and revenue estimates by platform, categories, countries, and date. Use this endpoint for category denominators rather than approximating totals from a top-app list; raw revenue is in cents.
